kpis.description_fr: Croissance NOI same-store apartments. KPI sector phare REIT residential. Décélération continue (supply Sunbelt + tax).
kpis.description_en: Same-store NOI growth apartments. Top residential REIT KPI. Continued deceleration (Sunbelt supply + tax).

kpis.description_fr: Taux occupation same-store. Stable très élevé, témoigne demand-supply balance globalement OK malgré Sunbelt.
kpis.description_en: Same-store occupancy. Stable very high, signals overall demand-supply balance despite Sunbelt softness.

kpis.description_fr: Hausse loyers blended (new + renewal). New leases ~0-1%, renewals ~3-4%. Reflète Sunbelt soft (Austin, Nashville).
kpis.description_en: Blended rent growth (new + renewal). New leases ~0-1%, renewals ~3-4%. Reflects soft Sunbelt (Austin, Nashville).

kpis.description_fr: Unités apartments. Croissance modeste (capital recyclage, focus operating efficiency). Geo mix : ~50% coastal, 50% sunbelt.
kpis.description_en: Apartment units. Modest growth (capital recycling, operating efficiency focus). ~50% coastal, 50% sunbelt geo mix.

kpis.description_fr: NOI margin (NOI / total rental revenue). Stable, témoigne efficience operating. Programme Customer Experience Project drive cost saves.
kpis.description_en: NOI margin (NOI / total rental revenue). Stable, signals operating efficiency. Customer Experience Project drives cost saves.
